notes.title: New monster update

notes.title: Krampus is Out!
notes.content: Added the Christmas Monster Krampus to Monster Clicker!  He'll be around for a month, and you should be able to get a lot of main game bonuses from him![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890885/12b9c3ec65d7a9a364c7e1dbe813797ac9ba8398.gif[/img]

notes.title: Be on the lookout for Krampus!
notes.content: Krampus will be coming to town during the December month, so be on the lookout![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890885/12b9c3ec65d7a9a364c7e1dbe813797ac9ba8398.gif[/img]
